reviews.title: Great value, amazing microphone for the buck
reviews.comment: This microphone is great, sounds great, easy to use and install, lots of features through Logitech G Hub and the price was amazing, it says refurbished but the product came to me in mint condition, only the package shown signs os use but the important part, the microphone, was completely new. I totally recommend this product and this seller.
reviews.author: Fernando Spray

reviews.title: Best gaming mic if you share a room
reviews.comment: Best mic I’ve gotten so far the quality of the sound has met my expectations. It’s pretty small so it doesn’t protrude on my desk. The software program you can get with it is really easy to use. Has helped reduce sound as I share a room.
reviews.author: Miya Torres

reviews.title: Over all Very nice , i think i would recommend
reviews.comment:
Why did you pick this product vs others?:
Well I bit the bullet on this one. To me this is a expensive mic but its cheaper than replacing my headphone mic, lots of video reveiws told me this could be the right mmic but often stated it was to much$$$ to finding it renewed for $70 off seemed like a logical YES
Microphone quality:
so how does it work 
on the desk ? with some distance,,, 4 stars
right up close on a stand? 5 stars
will it go the distance if i project,, a bit but this is clearly not what this mic is for
my set up is a large 20x33ft living room area with a fish tank , my 8 fan PC and AC alway running, thou you can see the fish tank noise on the level indicator, its all blocked, im getting used to the how to use but over all my noise floor is not a issue.
the LEDS are fine i dont need them and the lights are ok at showing you whats going on. but i dont need that. ill try to add a video later
reviews.author: Fjrn

reviews.title: Really good but smallll problems with it
reviews.comment: The software in my opinion is the best software for all my devices (which is the ghub) the mic is really good. Except it picks up on like everything but after a quick 5 minutes youtube tutorial for the mic settings i was able to get it to isolate my voice only for the most part. it still picks up my keyboard but that’s partly my fault since im waiting for the boom arm at the time of this review. Overall i would suggest it if you want a pretty good mic and def suggest it if you use the ghub like i do.
